INITRAMFS_VERSION.description: Specific version of initramfs to install.

INITRAMFS_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install INITRAMFS. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager.

LIBSCRIPT_INITRAMFS_COMPRESS.description: Compression algorithm used when packing cpio newc initramfs archives.

LIBSCRIPT_LUKS_CMDLINE.description: Optional cryptdevice/root kernel command-line override injected into early-userspace init.

LIBSCRIPT_INIT_SMOKE_ROOT.description: Optional staging root path used when running early-userspace init smoke tests.

LIBSCRIPT_INIT_SMOKE_EXIT.description: Flag (0 or 1) causing synthesized /init to exit cleanly after LUKS2/mount verification in smoke tests.
